templates.name: Case count by status
templates.description: Count of cases grouped by their current status
templates.sql: SELECT `case`.`status`, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM `case` WHERE `case`.`status` NOT IN ('REMOVED') GROUP BY `case`.`status` ORDER BY case_count DESC

templates.name: Cases created in date range
templates.description: List cases created within a specific date range
templates.sql: SELECT `case`.`id`, `case`.`shortId`, `case`.`status`, `case`.`typeOfDispute`, `case`.`createdAt` FROM `case` WHERE `case`.`createdAt` >= {start_date} AND `case`.`createdAt` < {end_date} ORDER BY `case`.`createdAt` DESC

templates.name: Payment summary by type
templates.description: Total payment amounts grouped by payment type
templates.sql: SELECT p.`type`, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(p.`amount`) AS total_amount FROM `payment` p WHERE p.`status` != 'REMOVED' GROUP BY p.`type` ORDER BY total_amount DESC

templates.name: Overdue cases
templates.description: Cases past their due date that are still open
templates.sql: SELECT `case`.`id`, `case`.`shortId`, `case`.`status`, `case`.`typeOfDispute`, `case`.`primaryDueDate`, `case`.`createdAt` FROM `case` WHERE `case`.`primaryDueDate` < CURDATE() AND `case`.`status` NOT IN ('CLOSED_DEFAULT','CLOSED_INITIATING_PARTY','CLOSED_NON_INITIATING_PARTY','CLOSED_ADMINISTRATIVE','CLOSED_SPLIT_DECISION','NOTICE_OF_DISMISSAL_NON_PAYMENT','INELIGIBLE') ORDER BY `case`.`primaryDueDate` ASC

templates.name: Cases by organization
templates.sql: SELECT o.`name` AS organization_name, o.`type` AS org_type, COUNT(cp.`caseId`) AS case_count FROM `organization` o JOIN `case_party` cp ON cp.`organizationId` = o.`id` GROUP BY o.`id`, o.`name`, o.`type` ORDER BY case_count DESC

templates.name: Monthly case creation trend
templates.description: Number of cases created per month
templates.sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`case`.`createdAt`, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM `case` WHERE `case`.`createdAt` >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {months} MONTH) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

templates.name: Payments for a specific case
templates.description: All payments associated with a particular case
templates.sql: SELECT p.`id`, p.`type`, p.`amount`, p.`status`, p.`direction`, p.`createdAt` FROM `payment` p JOIN `case_payment_allocation` cpa ON cpa.`paymentId` = p.`id` WHERE cpa.`caseId` = {case_id} ORDER BY p.`createdAt` DESC

templates.name: Arbitrator caseload
templates.description: Number of cases assigned to each arbitrator
templates.sql: SELECT u.`firstName`, u.`lastName`, COUNT(ca.`caseId`) AS assigned_cases FROM `user` u JOIN `case_arbitrator` ca ON ca.`userId` = u.`id` WHERE ca.`status` = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY u.`id`, u.`firstName`, u.`lastName` ORDER BY assigned_cases DESC

templates.name: Eligibility review queue
templates.description: Cases currently in eligibility review status
templates.sql: SELECT `case`.`id`, `case`.`shortId`, `case`.`typeOfDispute`, `case`.`status`, `case`.`createdAt`, `case`.`eligibilityDueDate` FROM `case` WHERE `case`.`status` IN ('INITIAL_ELIGIBILITY_REVIEW', 'PENDING_RFI_RESPONSE') ORDER BY `case`.`eligibilityDueDate` ASC

templates.name: IP/NIP payment status per case
templates.description: Payment totals for initiating and non-initiating parties
templates.sql: SELECT c.`shortId`, c.`typeOfDispute`, c.`status`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.`partyType` = 'INITIATING_PARTY' THEN p.`amount` END), 0) AS ip_total_paid, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.`partyType` = 'NON_INITIATING_PARTY' THEN p.`amount` END), 0) AS nip_total_paid FROM `case` c LEFT JOIN `case_party` cp ON cp.`caseId` = c.`id` LEFT JOIN `case_payment_allocation` cpa ON cpa.`caseId` = c.`id` LEFT JOIN `payment` p ON p.`id` = cpa.`paymentId` AND p.`type` = 'CASE_PAYMENT' AND p.`status` = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY c.`id`, c.`shortId`, c.`typeOfDispute`, c.`status` ORDER BY c.`createdAt` DESC
